entities.name: Borderlands
entities.description: An island southwest of Almaaz in the Terisian Isles on Dominaria, formerly on the mainland Terisiare.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: A larger island near the Borderlands, claimed by Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza who laid claim to Almaaz.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother of Mishra who sent an army to Almaaz.

entities.name: Porros
entities.description: The songmage prince of Almaaz who summoned the Beast of the Hours and murdered Samor.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: A cockatrice summoned by Porros, bound beneath Mount Sarraza until freed and banished.

entities.name: Samor the Collector
entities.description: A magic user who bound the Beast beneath Mount Sarraza and was murdered by Porros.

entities.name: Sarraza
entities.description: The mountain where the Beast of the Hours was bound.

entities.name: Chimes
entities.description: A secret valley populated by elves, destroyed in 3050 AR.

entities.name: Drufalden
entities.description: A queen who created an ice kingdom in the Borderlands.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: A songmage who melted the glacier and freed the Beast of the Hours in 3050 AR.

entities.name: River Kingdom of Selkies
entities.description: A kingdom of semi-aquatic shape-changing people on the Sarrazan River.

entities.name: Silver Sea
entities.description: An inland sea formed in the Thaw.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra during which the Borderlands were on the mainland.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: The period in which the Great Glacier froze the Lat-Nam Straits and Halquina Mountains.

events.summary: After Mishra claims Almaaz, Urza sends an army; Prince Porros summons the Beast of the Hours to devastate both armies.
events.quote: The prince of Almaaz , a songmage named Porros , used the opportunity to sow chaos

events.summary: Samor the Collector binds the Beast beneath Mount Sarraza, then is murdered by Porros before finishing a spell for Mishra to release it.
events.quote: Samor prepared a spell but was murdered by Porros before he could complete it.

events.summary: Queen Drufalden creates an ice kingdom in the Borderlands, locking water in a glacier and drying up the Sarrazan River.
events.quote: queen Drufalden created an ice kingdom for herself in the Borderlands

events.summary: In 3050 AR Ogwater Rifkin melts the glacier by song magic and frees and banishes the Beast of the Hours, destroying the Chimes.
events.quote: The Beast was finally banished, ending its threat over the Borderlands after more than 3000 years.

relations.quote: Samor the Collector used his magic to bind the creature beneath Mount Sarraza
